topic: The Magic of Pure Fourier Series: Breaking Down Complex Waves

sections.title: The Intuitive Hook: The 'Smoothie' Analogy
lecture_lines: Complex waves are like blended fruit smoothies.
We can extract pure sine wave ingredients.
This decomposition is a Fourier Series.
animations: Show a blended complex wave in dark cyan (#008B8B) using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/blender.svg] icon to represent the blending process.

Animate extraction of three sine waves in orange (#FF8C00), violet (#EE82EE), and lime green (#32CD32), where each wave appears like a piece of [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/fruit.svg].
Highlight the Fourier Series label in white (#FFFFFF) appearing over the waves.

sections.title: Mathematical Prerequisites: Orthogonality
lecture_lines: Waves are vectors in function space.
animations: Draw two perpendicular arrows representing function space axes in blue (#00BFFF) and yellow (#FFFF00).
Display sine and cosine waves to demonstrate non-overlapping orthogonality, accompanied by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/violin.svg].
Animate the vectors aligning to these axes to represent the basis.

sections.title: The Fourier Series Formula: The Anatomy of the Equation
lecture_lines: The formula sums sine and cosine terms.
Coefficients define the weight of each.
animations: Show the Fourier summation formula clearly in white (#FFFFFF).
Flash coefficients a_n (yellow #FFFF00) and b_n (orange #FF8C00) to highlight them.
Simulate digital equalizer bars [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/equalizer.svg] rising, colored cyan (#00CED1), relative to the coefficients.

sections.title: Visualizing Convergence: The Square Wave
lecture_lines: Start with one simple sine wave.
Watch the robotic hand trace corners.
animations: Show a base sine wave (white #FFFFFF) oscillating.
Overlay the 3rd harmonic (light orange #FFD700) to show addition.
Add 5th and 7th harmonics (light violet #D8BFD8) to the sum.
Morph the wave into a square shape (cyan #40E0D0) as harmonics are added.
Highlight the square corners appearing as the function converges, using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/hand.svg] to point at the sharp corners.

sections.title: Application and Conclusion: Signal Compression
lecture_lines: We discard the noise for compression.
animations: Highlight dominant red (#FF4500) coefficient bars in the spectrum using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/microphone.svg] as the input source indicator.
Show low-frequency noise fading away to illustrate compression.

Animate the reconstruction sequence: Original to Coefficients to Compressed to Reconstructed, ending with the data stored on the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/harddrive.svg].
